# The grinder mistake costing you flavour

**Hook archetype:** Negative framing ("stop doing X") + demonstrated outcome
**Structure:** Myth / Correction — the belief, why it's wrong, what to do instead
**Title (searchable, hook-first):** Why your coffee tastes different every single morning

---

## Hook (first 3 seconds)
**On-screen text:** "Your grinder is wrecking your coffee."
**Visual:** Tight shot of a blade grinder lid popping off — uneven grounds spilling out, some powder, some chunks. Same frame works muted.
**VO:** "If your coffee tastes different every morning, it's not the beans."

---

## Body

**Scene 1 — Name the culprit (≈3s)**
- **Visual:** Split frame. LEFT: blade grinder spinning chaotically. RIGHT: burr grinder turning steady.
- **On-screen text:** "Blades chop. Burrs crush."
- **VO:** "A blade grinder doesn't grind — it smashes beans at random."

**Scene 2 — The proof (≈4s)**
- **Visual:** Pour the blade grounds onto a white plate. Push them around — visible boulders next to fine dust.
- **On-screen text:** "Boulders + dust = one cup"
- **VO:** "Big pieces under-extract and taste sour. Fine dust over-extracts and tastes bitter. You brew both at once."

**Scene 3 — Why it ruins the cup (≈4s)**
- **Visual:** Two cups side by side. One labelled "Even grind", one "Blade grind." Tap the uneven one.
- **On-screen text:** "Sour + bitter = muddy"
- **VO:** "That's why you can't repeat a good cup. The grind is never the same twice."

**Scene 4 — The fix (≈3s)**
- **Visual:** Burr grinder producing uniform grounds falling onto the same white plate — consistent, even.
- **On-screen text:** "Fix: a burr grinder"
- **VO:** "A burr grinder cuts every piece to the same size. Same grind, same cup, every time."

---

## CTA
**Visual:** Loop back to the two plates — uneven vs even — side by side.
**On-screen text:** "Save this before your next bean order."
**VO:** "Send this to the person who keeps blaming their beans."

*One ask, reshare-first — the payoff ("same grind, same cup") lands in Scene 4, before the ask.*
